stable.notes: Control keeps the server switches you set by hand through Update Server: live Continue, the Codex queue, session hooks, the glasses question and approval switches, and the Messages trail. Pairs with server 6.53.4, which adds Cancel run for a session’s current run from the glasses or phone (with glasses 6.9.529 or later); press Install hooks once after updating.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
